key.name: password-latin-layout
key.description: When a password field gets focus, switch to a Latin keyboard layout and show which layout is on; switch back when the field loses focus.

key.name: password-preferred-layouts
key.description: XKB layout ids, in order: a password field always switches to the first one that is configured, even from another Latin layout. If none is configured, a Latin layout is kept and a non-Latin one switches to the first Latin layout.

key.name: gloxi-keep-above
key.description: Keep the Gloxi window above all other windows. The Herkos confirmation dialog is always kept above.

key.name: gloxi-panel-edge
key.summary: Keep Gloxi at the right edge of the screen
key.description: Place the Gloxi window at the right edge of the screen, like a side panel, when it appears and when its size changes. Gloxi sets the size.

key.name: gloxi-panel-size
key.description: compact: the last lines of the chat and the input, at the bottom right; one-sixth or one-third: that share of the screen width, the whole height; custom: the size the person gave the window.

key.name: gloxi-dock
key.summary: Gloxi as a side panel of the Shell (experimental)
key.description: Show Gloxi as a panel the Shell draws in a strip at the right edge of the primary monitor, like a dock: maximised windows and notifications stay out of it. The panel talks to gloxid, the Gloxi service; a button in the top bar and Gloxi's own key open and close it.

key.name: gloxi-panel-key
key.summary: Key that opens and closes the Gloxi side panel
key.description: While gloxi-dock is on, the Shell itself listens for this key, so it works before the Gloxi app has run in the session. The same key as Gloxi asks for through the GlobalShortcuts portal; whichever gets it, the panel opens or closes.

key.name: gloxi-panel-open
key.summary: The Gloxi side panel is open
key.description: Whether the side panel (gloxi-dock) is open now; it stays as it was after the next login.

key.name: vpn-offered-networks
key.summary: Wi-Fi networks the VPN offer was shown for
key.description: Connection UUIDs of the shared Wi-Fi networks (those with a login page) after whose login the Shell already offered a VPN, so that it offers once per network. Clear the list to see the offer again.

key.name: rollback-noticed
key.summary: Failed snapshot whose automatic rollback was already shown
key.description: After an update fails its boot health check and Vilna goes back to a snapshot that worked, the Shell shows one notification. This is the number of the failed snapshot it was shown for, so that it is shown once. Clear it to see the notification again.

key.name: window-motion
key.description: vilna: windows open from slightly smaller with a fade (280 ms), close faster than they open, go to their dock icon and back (450 ms) and lift a little while dragged. reduced: no movement, only a short fade (100 ms). gnome: GNOME's own animations. With animations turned off in Settings nothing moves in any case.

key.name: window-wobble
key.description: A dragged window bends a little and springs back when let go. Only with the vilna window motion and with animations on.

key.name: widgets
key.description: A column of cards on the left of the desktop: clock, Gloxi, today in the calendar, weather and backups.

key.name: weather
key.description: The forecast comes from Open-Meteo for the place below.

key.name: weather-location
key.description: Name, latitude and longitude of a place the person chose. Empty: the capital of the system's country, so that no location of the person is sent.

key.name: weather-alerts
key.description: MeteoAlarm's warnings for the weather place on the weather card, and a notification for each orange or red one. The whole country's warnings are downloaded and matched on this computer.

key.name: alerts-metered
key.summary: Download warnings on a metered connection
key.description: Off: on a metered connection the warnings pause and the card asks first. The country's warnings are up to 0.5 MB every 10 minutes; the zone boundaries about 30 MB once per place.

key.name: alert-zones
key.summary: Warning zones of the weather place
key.description: Latitude and longitude of the weather place and the MeteoAlarm zones (EMMA_ID) it lies in, found on this computer. Cleared or stale: found again.

key.name: sound-theme
key.description: The Vilna sound theme for event sounds, or GNOME's own (freedesktop). The default is provisional until every theme is ready.

key.name: disabled-sounds
key.description: Event sounds (freedesktop names, such as device-added) that stay silent whatever the theme. All sounds off is org.gnome.desktop.sound event-sounds.
